meta.title: focus on me — Try before you buy
meta.description: See any outfit on yourself before you buy it. AI virtual try-on with 4,000+ real products, results in about 30 seconds, and photos that never leave your phone.

hero.sub: See any outfit on yourself before you order it. Pick a piece, add your photo, and in about 30 seconds you know if it's a yes.
hero.note: Free credits when you sign up · Photos never stored

how.sub: Browse the catalog, pick what you like, then see it on you, before spending a single euro.

steps.title: Pick a piece, or upload your own
steps.desc: Browse over 4,000 real products from shops you already know, or upload a photo of any garment you like. Either way, you're one tap away from trying it on.

steps.title: Add your photo
steps.desc: Pick a photo from your gallery or take a new one. That's all the AI needs.

steps.title: See yourself wearing it
steps.desc: In about 30 seconds, see how it looks on you. Love it? Buy it from the retailer. Not feeling it? Keep browsing.

items.title: Any garment, not just the catalog
items.desc: Saw something on another site, or in your own wardrobe? Upload a photo of the garment and try it on the same way.

items.title: Results in ~30 seconds
items.desc: A realistic try-on rendered while you wait. No queue, no email, no switching apps.

items.title: 4,000+ products
items.desc: Real items from real retailers, with real prices. The catalog keeps growing.

items.title: Your photos stay yours
items.desc: Your photo is used only to generate the result, then deleted. Nothing is stored in the cloud and nothing is used to train AI models.

items.title: Share your looks
items.desc: Save the result and post it straight to TikTok or Instagram.

items.title: 8 languages
items.desc: English, Romanian, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese and Dutch.

items.title: Free to start
items.desc: You get free credits when you sign up. Buy more only if you want to.

credits.title_b: Pay only if you love it.
credits.sub: Every try-on uses one credit. No subscription, no card needed to start.

items.title: Free credits at sign-up
items.desc: Create an account and try the app right away.

items.title: Credit packs when you need more
items.desc: Buy extra credits inside the app. Purchased credits don't expire.

items.title: Handled by Apple and Google
items.desc: Payments go through the App Store or Google Play. We never see your card.

credits.note: Refunds are handled by Apple or Google.

items.a: Yes. You get free credits when you create an account. If you run out, you can buy credit packs inside the app, but you never have to.
The result is an AI-generated preview that shows how a piece looks on your body, colour and proportions. It's a visual guide, not a fitting guarantee, so always check the retailer's size chart.
It's sent to our AI service only when you tap Try On, used to render your result, then deleted. We don't keep it, we don't train models with it, and the result is saved only on your phone.

items.q: Where do the products come from?
items.a: From the online shops of real retailers, through affiliate networks. You buy directly from the retailer, at the retailer's price.

items.q: Can I try on clothes that aren't in the catalog?
items.a: Yes. Upload a photo of any garment, from a website, a screenshot or your own wardrobe, and the app renders it on you just like a catalog item.

items.q: Do I buy clothes inside the app?
items.a: No. focus on me shows you the item on you and sends you to the retailer's website to complete the purchase. Delivery, sizing and returns are handled by the retailer.

items.q: How long does a try-on take?
items.a: Around 30 seconds, depending on your connection.

items.q: Can I get a refund on credits?
items.a: Payments are processed by Apple or Google, so refund requests go through them. Our refund policy explains exactly how.

items.q: How old do I have to be?
items.a: At least 13, or the minimum age for data consent in your country. Between 13 and 18 you need a parent's or guardian's consent.

cta.sub: Launching soon on the App Store and Google Play.
